issue.title: test_rows_apply_and_loading_clears_while_cleanup_is_blocked fails under full lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Node-specific follow-up from phase sase-124.8.2. During its unchanged-tree just check, the governed full parallel lane failed this ACE TUI loader-cleanup timing test; the exact node and the complete test file both passed immediately afterward. Root cause is not established. Re-measure with just test-contention and the reproducible-flake baseline before changing production behavior. RELATED: retired umbrella sase-ct requires narrow task routing for this failure shape.

task_type_fields.evidence: Observed once in the governed full parallel lane on 2026-09-17 while phase sase-124.8.2 verified unrelated attention scheduling changes. The exact node and its full file passed on immediate serial reruns on the same tree, so the observed fail rate is 1/1 full-lane attempts and 0/2 immediate serial reruns. The proposing phase did not capture a traceback or prove a root cause. The test has explicit 0.5-2.0 second timing bounds and blocked-thread coordination, making contention measurement the next required evidence.
